notes: One entry per kind of creature. The key is its id, used in level files.
name, text: shown to the player. Keep them plain.
kind: dead, beast, myth or rival.
health: how much damage it takes. speed: metres a second. radius, height, wide: its size in metres. deadSize: how much bigger its dead picture is drawn (1 if left out).
sense: 'sight' = it must see you, and sees less far when you are in the dark. 'life' = the dead: light makes no difference.
sight: how far it notices you, in metres. hearing: how far it hears running and fighting.
attack: damage, type (cut, stab or crush), reach in metres, windup = seconds of warning before the blow lands, recover = seconds before it can attack again.

weak: how much of each kind of damage gets through. 1 = normal, 2 = double, 0.5 = half. arrow: the same for arrows from a bow (1 if left out): little for bone, shell and stone, double for things that fly. bare: the same for bare fists (1 if left out).

zones: where an arrow from a bow does more or less harm (src/fight.js arrowHit). vital: [from, to, its name] bands of its height (0 its feet, 1 its top): an arrow in one, near its middle line, does 2.5 times the harm. low: [height, name]: below that (a leg, tentacles) it does 0.6 times. side: the name of what is out at its edge (an arm, a wing): 0.6 times too. A thing of stone has none, and neither has the scarab (Mirko: a scarab would not have one).
still + wake: it stands like a statue until you come within 'wake' metres, or hit it.
prowl: while it has not noticed you it walks about slowly, this many metres at most from where it was put (beasts do this anyway).
fleeAt: it runs away once when its health falls below this part (0.35 = 35%).
wade: the deepest water it will walk into, in metres.
xp: experience for killing it (not used yet). drops: [item id, chance 0..1] pairs left when it dies.
look: stand-in picture. shape: biped or beast. colour, eyes: hex colours. detail: wraps or bones. weapon: spear or none.
weak.fire: how badly it burns. 0 = it cannot be set alight; leave it out for 1. A lit torch (weapon with fire:true) sets a creature alight for a few seconds, and it loses health fast while it burns.
boss:true marks a guardian that holds something (the colossus of Ptah guards the gem). detail 'stone' draws a thick, blocky body.

fly: it flies and keeps off the ground. cruise: how high over its place it idles. circle: the radius it circles there (0: it drifts up and down). hover: how far over your feet it holds itself to strike. swoop: seconds it climbs away after a blow before it comes again. beat: wing beats (or pulses) a second. bob: how much it rises and falls as it hangs.

jackal.name: Black jackal
jackal.text: A black jackal with red eyes.

bone_guard.name: Bone guard
bone_guard.text: A skeleton with a spear. It guards this place.

skin.label: PULLING A BONE
skin.done: You pull a leg bone from the bone guard.

wrapped_dead.name: Wrapped dead
wrapped_dead.text: A dead man in linen wrappings.

skin.label: UNWRAPPING
skin.done: You strip the wrappings from the dead man.

rotting_dead.name: Rotting dead
rotting_dead.text: A dead man, half rotted away. It is quick.

skin.label: UNWRAPPING
skin.done: You strip a bandage from the rotting dead.

scarab_beetle.name: Sacred scarab
scarab_beetle.text: A beetle as big as a dog, with a shell like blue stone. Blades bounce off it.

ptah_colossus.name: Colossus of Ptah
ptah_colossus.text: A giant of grey stone, green with moss, the maker's own guardian. Its fists are hammers.

sky_lizard.name: Flying lizard
sky_lizard.text: A lizard with leather wings wider than a man is tall. It dives at you, then climbs away and comes round again.

thin_demon.name: Thin demon
thin_demon.text: A thin grey thing on long legs, with claws as long as knives. It is very quick.

sky_jelly.name: Sky jelly
sky_jelly.text: A jelly that floats in the air like a bell of glass. Its long threads sting.
